content.text:
The button between the Code and Spec tabs now shows a broken chain, and switches to a joined chain when it's selected. Before, it was always a `+`.

The change is in `src/chat_input.rs`, using the `Unlink` and `Link` icons from the icon set the app already loads. I also replaced the leftover `+` wording in the comments and test messages, and renamed the test `plus_tab_overlaps_the_tabs` to `chain_tab_overlaps_the_tabs`. All 14 chat input tests pass. The tests don't look at which icon is drawn, so I haven't seen the new icons on screen in the running app.
